key_insight: Under conventional training, capsule networks showed greater adversarial robustness than the tested CNNs and vision transformer across all five datasets.
clinical_relevance: Capsule networks may help improve medical image classifier reliability under adversarial perturbations, but clinical safety and effectiveness remain unestablished.
method: Compared two capsule networks, ResNet-18, ResNet-50, and MedViT.
Evaluated five adversarial attack approaches and conducted PGD adversarial fine-tuning.
Used latent-space and Grad-CAM analyses to examine representation stability.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covered four medical imaging datasets and MNIST; visualizations suggested more stable capsule-network representations and attention maps after perturbation.
watch_item: The supplied abstract is incomplete and provides no numerical effect sizes or results after adversarial fine-tuning.
paper_title: Adversarial Robustness of Capsule Networks for Medical Image Classification
